maddeler.e:
نختبئ (form VIII)
# نَخْتَبِئُ (naḵtabiʔu) /nax.ta.bi.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# نَخْتَبِئَ (naḵtabiʔa) /nax.ta.bi.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# نَخْتَبِئْ (naḵtabiʔ) /nax.ta.biʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
